17297.「巨人族よ！ ボクの声が 聞こえるか？<yesno><close>:
You, giant! Are you able to hear me?
<yesno><close>

17298.「おお！ 聞こえているか！\n どうやら術は 成功したようだな！:
My word! So you CAN hear me!
I suppose it worked, then!

17299.「おどろかせて すまない。\n 今のは ボクと 巨人族であるキミが\n 言葉を交:
Apologies if I scared you. That little magic
from before allows you, a giant, and I to
talk with one another.

17300.「ボクの名は シグルド！\n 世界の均衡を守るべく戦う ヴァルハラの戦士！:
Call me Sigurd! As a warrior from Valhalla, I
strive to keep this world in balance and
harmony!

17301.「キミの名は…… そうか <cs_pchero>か！\n ボクの想像どおり 猛々:
And you are...? I see... <cs_pchero>!
It's just as imaginedーfierce, yet beautiful!

17302.「勇猛な巨人族 <cs_pchero>よ！\n キミは 気づいているか？\n 我:
Valiant giant! Have you felt it too?
The world's balance has begun to
teeter.

17303.「ボクは それを食い止めるために 長い旅を\n していたが その途中で 先ほどの:
I had set on a long journey to put a stop to
it, but on my way I was captured by that large
bird and trapped here in its nest.

17305.「まったく とんだ目にあったが\n これも <cs_pchero>に 出会うため:
It was quite the ordeal...but perhaps it was
fate. It seems I was destined to meet you
here, <cs_pchero>.

17306.「キミに 相談したいことがあるんだ。\n すまないが 仲間の待つ ヴァルハラの館:
There's something I need to discuss with you. I hate to ask this of you, but...
Do you think you could take me to the Halls of Valhalla? That's where my companions are waiting for me.

17307.「……なんだって？\n キミは 人に頼まれて 巨鳥に奪われた指輪を\n 取り返し:
What's that? Someone sent you here to get
back a ring from that giant bird?

17308.「それなら 優先すべきは その使命だな。\n まずは その指輪を 持ち主に届けよ:
Then that is our first priority!
We must deliver that ring to its rightful
owner!

17309.「勇猛な巨人族 <cs_pchero>よ！\n ボクの足では 移動するのに 時間:
Valiant giant! It takes a long time for me to
get around walking on my own. I'll just
hop into your bag instead!

17311.かばんの中から シグルドの声が聞こえる。:
Sigurd begins to speak from inside your
bag...

17312.「どうやら これで\n キミの使命は 済んだようだな！:
Looks like you were successful in your
mission!

17313.「それでは すまないが ボクの仲間が待つ\n ヴァルハラの館へ 向かってくれ！:
Now then, I once again apologizeーplease
take me to the Halls of Valhalla!
My companions await!

17314.「じつは 幸運なことに ヴァルハラの館は\n この 巨人族の町にあるんだ！:
And how fortunate for usーthe Halls are
right here in this town of giants!

17315.「あの階段を上がれば 巨人族の住まう\n 特別 大きな家がある。そこに入って\n:
Up those stairs is a special abode where some
giants live. Once inside, enter the room on
the right with the pink-colored door!

17316.「皆！ 遅くなって すまない！\n ボクだ！ 今 帰ったぞ！！:
Sorry I took so long, everyone!
It's me! I've returned!

17317.「おおっ シグルド様！！\n よくぞ…… ご無事で お帰りになりました！:
Oh, Sigurd!
Thank goodness...I'm so glad to see you
back safe and sound!

17318.「おケガが ねえようで なによりです。\n アッシらは 皆 シグルド様の お帰り:
It's good to see that you are not hurt.
We've all anxiously awaited your return.

17319.「ところで その巨人族は……？:
By the way, what is that giant doing
here...?

17320.「あの者の 視線をあびても\n 身体が動く！ ということは…………:
My body is able to move under <if_woman>her<else>his<endif>
gaze! Then, that means...

17321.「シグルド様！ ついに巨人族の戦士に\n ふさわしき者を このヴァルハラの館へと:
You've done it, Sigurd! At last you have
brought a worthy giant to these Halls!

17322.「<pc>。我々 ヴァルハラの戦士は\n 先ほどの術の かかっていない 巨人族の:
As the warriors of Valhalla, we freeze up if
we are exposed to the gaze of a giant who
hasn't had that special magic cast on them.

17323.「これは 我々が 世の理に背いたゆえの制約。\n ヴァルハラの戦士は もとは皆\:
This restriction was born from us having defied the world's natural order.
After all, those who exist in Valhalla were once brave warriors in life.

17325.「さあ！ キミを このヴァルハラの館へ\n 招いた理由を話そう。:
Right! Allow me to tell you why I invited
you here.

17326.<center>キミたち 巨人族は 知らないだろう。\n世界は 調停者オーディン:
As a giant, you likely do not know of this.
This world is ruled by a mighty being
known as Odin.

17327.<center>万物は 調停者オーディンにより\nその形 その在り方を さだめら:
All things are permitted to exist by his will.
He determines what form they take, and
their way of being.

17328.<center>その オーディンの かたわらには\n我らの主であり 世界の均衡を:
At his side was our masterーthe Valkyrie
of Fate. She wields the power to give
balance to this world.

17329.<center>しかし…… 調停者オーディンは\n突如 天命の戦乙女を いずこか:
But for reasons unknown...Odin spirited her
away to places unknown and began to
shatter the world's balance.

17330.<center>オーディンは……\nこの世界を 闇に葬ろうとしているのだ。:
Odin, he...
He wishes to cover the world in darkness.

17331.「……我々は ヴァルハラの戦士だ！\n 必ずや 我らが主 天命の戦乙女を奪還し\:
We are the warriors of Valhalla! We will take
back our master, and restore balance to the
world!

17333.「天命の戦乙女の 行方を探すためには\n 三賢人と呼ばれる方々の おチカラを\n:
In order to find the Valkyrie's whereabouts,
we must enlist the help of the Three Sages.

17334.「三賢人とは 英知の結晶……。世界の均衡を\n より堅牢なものとする チカラを持:
The Sages are the embodiment of wisdom itself...they possess the ability to secure the balance of the world.
However, we have been unable to discern their whereabouts...

17336.「勇猛なる巨人族 <pc>よ！\n このヴァルハラの館には 古来より\n ある言:
Valiant giant! Here in the Halls, an ancient
legend has been passed down over many
generations.

17337.「世界の均衡が 崩れかけし時\n 選ばれたる巨人族の戦士が 我らの道標となり\n:
"When the world's balance begins to sway, A chosen giant shall lead the way.
"Their warrior's light shall be our guide, And save the world from darkness wide."

17338.「ボクは あの巨鳥と戦うキミを見て 確信した！\n 巨人族の戦士に ふさわしき者:
I was convinced when I saw you fight that
giant bird! You are the only one deemed worthy
to fulfill the legend!

17339.「<pc>！ 我ら ヴァルハラの戦士の\n 道標になってくれ！ 盟友の契りを結び:
You must be a beacon to us warriors of
Valhalla! Forge with us a pact of comradeship
and fight with us, side by side!<yesno><close>

17340.「しかし このままでは 世界は\n 闇に 葬り去られてしまう！\n 頼む……キミ:
If you don't, then this world will surely
be plunged into darkness! Please...we
need your strength!

17341.「ありがとう <pc>！\n キミなら そう言ってくれると 信じていた！: Thank you! I just knew you'd accept!

17342.<if_woman>「皆 しかと見よ！\n 彼女こそが 我らの道標となる\n 巨:
Behold! This <if_woman>woman<else>man<endif> is the
chosen giant of legend, <pc>!
<if_woman>She<else>He<endif> will guide us forward!

17343.「心強き 盟友を得た今\n 我らの勝利は 約束されたも同然だ！:
With such a strong ally in tow, our victory
is all but assured!

17345.「フッ バカバカしい。\n 付き合っていられませんね。:
Hmph. This is ridiculous.
I don't have the time to deal with your
nonsense.

17346.「愚鈍な巨人族ごときが\n 調停者オーディンを相手に\n 何が できるというので:
What could a measly giant hope to do against
the mighty Odin?

17349.「ハーゲンよ。キミの 戦士としての能力は\n ボクも買っている……。しかし 盟友:
Hagen...though I admire your ability as a
warrior, I will not allow you to slander our
new ally!

17350.「さあ 巨人族の戦士 <pc>よ！\n 粗末な品だが これを受け取ってくれ。\n:
This is for you, valiant giant! While it isn't
much, I'm sure that it will still help you
even just a little!

17351.「我々は 全力を尽くして\n 三賢人の居場所を 探しだしてみせる！:
We will do everything in our power to locate
the whereabouts of the Three Sages!

17352.「何か わかったことがあれば しらせよう。\n それまでは 休息を取っていてくれ:
I will contact you if I learn anything.
In the meantime, be sure to rest yourself!

17353.「巨人族の戦士 <pc>よ！\n 今 ボクたちは 全力を尽くして\n 三賢人の居:
Valiant giant! We've been diligently working
to locate the Three Sages.

17354.「何か わかったことがあれば しらせよう。\n それまでは 休息を取っていてくれ:
I will contact you if I learn anything.
In the meantime, be sure to rest yourself!
